description: This file defines a Ninject module for configuring dependency injection bindings for logging strategies, and a custom instance provider class for creating log strategy instances based on a log type parameter.

classes.name: LogModule
classes.description: A NinjectModule that sets up bindings for different ILogStrategy implementations based on log levels and a factory for creating log strategies dynamically.

classes.name: UseLogTypeAsNameInstanceProvider
classes.description: A custom StandardInstanceProvider that creates ILogStrategy instances based on the log type argument passed to the factory method.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Configures the kernel with bindings for different log strategies named by log level and sets up a factory for creating log strategy instances based on log type.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Overrides the method to return the log type name from the arguments to create appropriate log strategy instances.
